video_title: She Hit The Gas Instead Of The Brake
evidence: SponsorRadar identifies Setpower as the sponsor of Pepe's Towing Service's August 12, 2026 English-language YouTube video 'She Hit The Gas Instead Of The Brake'. The channel has about 368K subscribers and SponsorRadar tracks multiple Setpower placements with this creator. Setpower sells physical portable refrigerators/freezers. Setpower's current official Collabs page describes an influencer partnership program with affiliate marketing, campaigns and social co-creation, and explicitly directs creators to official@setpowerusa.com after posting collaboration content.
